# Canvas Sprint

A simple endless runner rendered on an HTML5 canvas. The player taps or presses space to make a square jump over incoming rectangular obstacles that scroll from right to left. The game ends (lose condition) when the square collides with an obstacle or falls off the ground. Score increments by distance traveled.
